# Progress Bar

```tsx
import { ProgressBar } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Shows how far a task has gone. Mirrors the Figma Progress Bar (Value 0–100, Color: Brand Gradient or Chart 1–9) and Progress Bar Label (Label Position: Top, Bottom or Side, with Show Label Left and Show Label Right).

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<ProgressBar {...args} aria-label="Progresso" />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Progress Bar and Progress Bar Label components:
- Bar: a 10px pill track in Background/Disabled/Soft, 240px wide, with the .Progress Bar Fill as wide as `value` (Figma Value=0…100).
- Color (.Progress Bar Fill): Brand Gradient (Progress Bar/Gradient/Start → End) or a Chart color, 1 to 9.
- Label Position: Top / Bottom (labels 4px from the bar, Left and Right at each end) or Side (12px on each side of the bar).
- Show Label Left / Show Label Right: which of the two labels show.
- Labels: Body/Small in Text/Primary.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ProgressBarProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color?` | `ProgressBarColor` | Figma "Color": Brand Gradient or Chart/1 to Chart/9. |
| `labelLeft?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Label Left": the label at the start of the bar. |
| `labelRight?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Label Right": the label at the end of the bar. |
| `labelPosition?` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "side"` | Figma "Label Position": above, below or beside the bar. |
| `showLabelLeft?` | `boolean` | Figma "Show Label Left". |
| `showLabelRight?` | `boolean` | Figma "Show Label Right". |

## Types

`ProgressBarColor`, `ProgressBarProps`

## Rules

- Import `ProgressBar` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
